spec.description: List commits reachable from a branch or sha, newest first. Pages are joined by `page`/`per_page`; the generated `list_commits_paged` walks them until a short page.

request.title: ListCommitsRequest
request.description: Which repository, an optional filter, and which page.

owner.description: Account owner of the repository, case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the `.git` extension, case-insensitive.

sha.description: Branch name or commit sha to start from; the default branch when omitted.

path.description: Only commits touching this file path.

author.description: Only commits by this GitHub login or email.

page.description: Page number of the results to fetch, starting at 1.

notes: The `page1`..`page4` examples are one real walk with `per_page: 3`, pinned to the 0.1.0 release commit through `sha` so re-recording yields the same 11 commits: three full pages and a short fourth, which is what ends `list_commits_paged`.
